current_checkpoint.summary: CI run 33819052516 passed Runtime, Swift, arm64, x86_64 and Universal gates for product commit 9981d8e. Product commit 4864976 adds a per-request ownership gate and stops initial loading after startup denial; CI and a fresh packaged native rerun are pending.
